label: Absence of a pure perfection at an unlimited root: three explanations and compiled E and L
summary: #2145 Investigation 1. Encoded the owner's three explanations of a pure perfection's absence at a root over one admissible profile family (TruthCore.Causality.RootPerfectionExclusion): exclusion by the admissibility constraints alone, by the positive profile (jointly; a single excluder is one case and pairwise compatibility does not suffice), or unexplained. absenceTrichotomy and absenceTrichotomyExclusive prove classical coverage and exclusivity relative to one family; the background (fixed family, positive nature as Has-profile, no extrinsic case at a root, purity outside the trichotomy) carries the content. The L bridge is derived in both limitation senses from joint compossibility plus the RootPurity bridge (structural) or a determination-to-esse bridge (formal); two root-reaching arguments compose E (no unexplained absence at actual roots) with L and the root's nonlimitation to conclude fe67d766, the second through rootUnlimited. Controls (two beings and one root relation; the anchoring control uses natural-number determinations) show each open premise of both routes load-bearing: the joint-conflict row is a non-contracting exclusion model in this encoding and fails only joint compossibility among the L inputs; the standing-rival row fails only E; exact closure fails pure admissibility; an infinite all-pure profile fails root-profile admissibility, and there the root's absence is vacuously a positive-profile exclusion, so case (ii) needs the root's profile to be admissible. The A8 classifier route makes absence itself limiting (contraposed fullness) and is not a discriminating L. Under the exercise-or-potency reading, pure act and ab esse ad posse, own aptitude and exercise coincide at an own-being source for self-directed contents; productive and exemplary roles survive in a joint model, not by a theorem: the #1892 ImpersonalEminence source, with its own capacity set equal to its apprehension and its Has profile linked to that apprehension by an explicit conjunct, satisfies the collapse premises and violates only E. A source whose Has profile has noesis but lacks an admissible pure determination violates E in the same form; it is a Has-profile parity check, not a personal variant of that source. E is neutral in form, but given the background it decides exactly the point at issue (restricted to pure determinations it is equivalent to the conclusion), so its support value equals the independent warrant for a closure principle at roots, which is not yet in the graph.
blocker: The derivation is conditional. Open: joint compossibility of pure determinations within the admissible family (positive rationale from DEF-PURE-PERFECTION, not a proof); E, no unexplained absence at actual roots (general rootless-determiner rationale; the rival's primitive closure is coherent and applies symmetrically); admissibility of noesis with simplicity (the articulation objection); admissibility of the root's actual profile; the determination-to-esse bridge; and purity of intellect itself, which the trichotomy does not classify.

current_assessment.scope: Absence of a pure perfection, including noesis, at an actual root: the three explanations relative to one admissible family, the derived L bridge in both limitation senses and the E premise, with the #1892 impersonal source as standing rival.
current_assessment.assessment: Conditional support for fe67d766 by two verified routes; no premise is established. Positive exclusion (ii) entails a limiting principle the root lacks given joint compossibility, the RootPurity or determination-to-esse bridge, and admissibility of the root's own profile (0a9d3a40). So (ii) survives at an unlimited root only by denying joint compossibility, which needs a positive incompatibility between limitation-free actualities (none is supplied), or root-profile admissibility, where (ii) holds only vacuously. Unexplained absence (iii) is excluded only by E, which nonlimitation and the existential PSR do not supply. E is neutral in form, but given the background it decides exactly the point at issue, so its support value equals the independent warrant for a closure principle of sufficient reason at roots, which is not yet in the graph; denying it is a coherent primitive closure. Incompatibility with simplicity (i) is the target of the articulation objection. For self-directed contents, the simplicity reading collapses own aptitude into exercise; a joint model, not a theorem, shows it leaves the productive and exemplary no-aptitude profile standing. No unconditional winner.
current_assessment.next_test: Give Admissible a constitutive reading and test whether joint compossibility is derivable; encode the #1879 two-fork articulation test as a restriction of the family; compare E with the feature-uniform norm of BruteContingencyParity; register the wisdom-to-intellect route to 29818edd with an explicit purity statement.
